site.description: Skills shipped to every HAXsite (per-site boilerplate). Curated explicit list — nothing ships to a site unless named here.

system.description: Skills shipped to HAXcms deployment roots (NodeJS app root + PHP root) — a superset of site for an agent operating a HAXcms deployment (creating/managing sites, CLI/plugin operation, rating, code-level schema audits, granular UbD course design). Excludes developer/ecosystem tooling (onboarding, issues, rules, importers, tutorial/audio publishing) which stays in praw only.
